research_route.action: Use one focused public web search per model for a current exact mainland JD/Tmall or attributable China seller item. Search and evaluate the four models sequentially; open at most one exact item per model. Verify exact identity/package, visible CNY amount, date or current order context, and stated conditions.
research_route.stop_rule: At most four new web attempts total, one per exact model. Stop each model after one exact item page or no result. Do not log in, enter account-only checkout, contact sellers, use XHS, convert foreign prices, treat official list prices as checkout, or transfer neighboring years/builds.

done_criteria: When a public exact mainland seller item establishes a current CNY amount and matching package, add a dated observed_price and source metadata only to that candidate, preserving all official/foreign references.
For each model with no exact public price and package, add one blocked/no-result retry and leave observed_price absent.
Run focused validation, coverage acceptance/check, and `npm run check` once for the coherent batch. No image report unless image records change.
